rules.statement: A platform boundary can only turn a Permit into Deny or Indeterminate (P-B2); without boundaries it is the identity (P-B1).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P-B1 a boundary that allows everything is the identity
engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P-B2 a boundary never permits what is not permitted without it
engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P-B3 a boundary decision does not depend on the candidate order
guards: runtime:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#boundaries live in the platform, only allow, and are never bound

rules.statement: A tenant's boundary is the platform's: only a platform principal sets it (403 otherwise, whatever the operator holds), only a platform principal approves a change that sets one, at approve and again at publish, and only a platform principal rejects or abandons one.
guards: control:ApprovalB2Test#only a platform principal sets a tenant's boundary or approves it
control:ApprovalB2Test#a boundary change a tenant principal approved does not publish
control:ApprovalB2Test#only a platform principal rejects or abandons a boundary change
